summary: Fix resolves the MultiOutputClassifier AttributeError, but discriminates meta-estimators via hasattr(estimator, 'estimators_'), which is too broad and mis-handles ensembles whose estimators_ are not per-label.

issues.description: Using `hasattr(estimator, 'estimators_')` as a proxy for MultiOutputClassifier is fragile. Many estimators expose `estimators_` where entries are NOT per-label sub-estimators (RandomForestClassifier/GradientBoosting/VotingClassifier/BaggingClassifier expose ensemble members). A more targeted check (isinstance MultiOutputClassifier / MetaEstimatorMixin, or presence of per-output classes_) would be safer.

Potential regression: RandomForestClassifier fit on multioutput y returns a list from predict_proba and previously worked via `estimator.classes_[i_label]` (a list of per-output class arrays). This patch now routes it through `estimator.estimators_[i_label].classes_`, indexing tree members as if they were labels, producing wrong class ordering/n_classes. cross_val_predict(method='predict_proba') on a bare multioutput forest could break.
The two branches duplicate the whole list comprehension differing only in the classes_ source; could be factored to compute the classes source once.
